title: Why Age? Should We End Aging Forever?
summary: Kurzgesagt's short animated video asks whether humanity should try to end aging, and argues the case for curing age-related disease. It is part one of a pair, with a second part by CGP Grey.
why: HN commenters recommend it as a compelling, concise argument for longevity research and a rebuttal to common objections to ending aging.

quote.text: A good counter-argument to commonly cited objections to biological immortality
